name: Pesto Chicken and Cauliflower Bake
evidence: No pesto or Italian-cream cauliflower/chicken bake exists in the 544-recipe catalog; the only cauliflower bakes are the accepted chicken-bacon-ranch-cauliflower-bake (bacon-ranch sauce family) and beef/turkey pasta-and-potato casseroles, and the nearest catalog chicken bakes (chicken-cordon-bleu-casserole, chicken-divan-broccoli-bake) use ham/Swiss and broccoli-mornay respectively, so pesto-mozzarella cream over roasted cauliflower is a distinct dish.
borderline_note: Shares protein (chicken), method (bake), and cauliflower base with the accepted chicken-bacon-ranch-cauliflower-bake, but the pesto-mozzarella Italian sauce family genuinely distinguishes the plate from bacon-ranch; three-of-four overlap resolved on the differentiating sauce, so KEEP not DUPE.
cross_protein_collision_watch: Structurally this is a sauce-bound, starch-free cauliflower-and-shredded-protein bake; a pesto turkey cauliflower bake (or pesto pork/ground-turkey version) in another selector's pool would be a same-dish-different-protein twin. Note also catalog turkey-pesto-pasta-kale shares the pesto flavor but is a pasta dish, not a collision. Decider should check turkey/pork pools for a pesto cauliflower bake.
